title: Future Investment Initiative 2026
body_summary: Global investment forum in Riyadh connecting investors and decision-makers.
body: The Future Investment Initiative (FII) is a global platform bringing together investors, government leaders, and business executives to explore opportunities in Saudi Arabia.

title: LEAP Tech Conference 2026
body_summary: Major technology event focused on innovation and digital transformation.
body: LEAP is one of the largest technology conferences in the region, attracting startups, investors, and enterprises exploring Saudi Arabia’s digital economy.

title: Private Sector Forum (PIF) 2026
body_summary: Key platform connecting private sector companies with investment opportunities.
body: The Private Sector Forum organized by PIF connects businesses with investment projects and strategic partnerships in Saudi Arabia.

title: GITEX Global 2026
body_summary: International technology exhibition connecting global businesses.
body: GITEX Global is a major technology and business event in Dubai, attracting companies looking to expand into the Middle East including Saudi Arabia.

title: Black Hat MEA 2026
body_summary: Cybersecurity event for enterprises and government sectors.
body: Black Hat Middle East & Africa is a leading cybersecurity event bringing together global experts and organizations.
